option_relations.rationale: Methimazole-induced vasculitis is a specific type of drug-induced vasculitis, but it is not directly equivalent to Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA).
Microscopic polyangiitis is a distinct ANCA-associated vasculitis, but it is not equivalent to Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA).
Drug-induced ANCA-associated vasculitis is a broader category that could include methimazole-induced vasculitis, but it is not equivalent to Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA).
Lupus vasculitis is a manifestation of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and is not equivalent to Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA).
